preconditions.description: The number of categories N must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= W <= 10 for W in category_word_counts)
preconditions.description: Each category must have between 1 and 10 associated words.
All words in the input must consist of at most 30 lower-case letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the names of the categories with the highest number of matches, sorted lexicographically.
There must be at least one category suggested in the output.
